meta.name: Analyze competitor pricing and feature changes with Google Gemini

name: Autonomous Competitor Pricing & Feature Changelog Intelligence Agent

parameters.content:
## Autonomous Competitor Pricing & Feature Changelog Intelligence Agent

### How it works

This workflow monitors competitor pricing and feature changelog snapshots on a manual test run or a weekly schedule. It preprocesses the previous and current snapshots, sends the detected changes to an AI market intelligence chain, then routes the result by threat level into urgent alerts, product digests, or minor logs. The selected branch is consolidated into a final market intelligence log for downstream review.

### Setup steps

- Configure the Google Gemini credentials used by the AI model node.
- Update the seeded competitor fields with the target competitor name, URL, previous snapshot, and current snapshot, or replace the seed node with a real data source.
- Review the weekly schedule trigger timing and timezone so it runs at the desired cadence.
- Verify the formatting code nodes and final log code node output to match the destination system or reporting format.

### Customization

Adjust the threat-level routing rules, AI prompt/parser schema, and alert formatting templates to match your competitive intelligence criteria and reporting channels.

## Trigger and seed input

Starts the workflow either manually or on the weekly schedule, then provides initial competitor pricing and changelog snapshot data for analysis.

## Prepare snapshot diff

Preprocesses the previous and current competitor snapshots into a cleaner diff payload for AI analysis.

## Analyze market intelligence

Uses a Gemini-backed LLM chain and structured parser to interpret the competitor changes and produce structured intelligence.

## Route and format alerts

Branches the AI result by threat level and formats the appropriate output as an urgent founder alert, product digest, or minor snapshot log.

## Consolidate final log

Merges the routed alert or digest output and writes the final market intelligence log.
